messages:
devin: heads-up — oncall requested a breakglass service-account key on the tenant dashboard for emergency model rollbacks. they want a 1-click activate. thoughts?
maya: oof. exposing a static key in UI feels risky. :grimacing:
raj: agree. if we do anything it should mint an ephemeral token with short TTL and require 2FA + approval flow.
sara: +1. also need to think about routing: which org/project does that key attribute to for billing/quotas? we can't create orphaned requests.
devin: on quotas — oncall expects it to bypass standard rate limits so they can drain traffic to fallback model. but we still need a quota accounting trail.
raj: propose: when breakglass used, route through a special fallback pathway that keeps metrics tagged with origin=breakglass and original_project for attribution. that way billing still attributes but we mark it in telemetry.
maya: UX: hide behind a feature flag, show warnings, and require two approvers for production tenants. maybe a modal: "This will mint a short-lived token and route traffic to fallback. Audit log will be generated." :warning:
devin: infra-bot, any policy snippets we can reuse for ephemeral SA minting?
infra-bot: snippet: ```
policy:
  action: mint_ephemeral_token
  ttl: 300s
  require_2fa: true
  audit_label: breakglass
``` 
infra-bot: also: generate audit-event with fields: actor, tenant_id, original_project, routed_model, quota_override_reason
sara: telemetry needs: counter for breakglass_activations, histogram of TTLs used, and a tag for whether quota override happened. we want alerts if >3 activations in 24h for same tenant.
raj: routing-wise, fallback path must be idempotent and enforce canary limits. even if we bypass rate limits, we should cap at an absolute ceiling to avoid runaway costs.
maya: console should show last 10 activations for tenant with links to raw audit logs + ability to revoke active tokens immediately.
devin: what about canary rollouts? oncall wants to flip 100% to fallback sometimes. should the breakglass token be able to toggle route percentages?
sara: allow toggles but require explicit checkbox: "Allow traffic split changes". record old split in audit log. don't allow from browser-only; require SSO+2FA.
raj: implementation note — reuse existing token-minting service but add a new claim: "breakglass:true". that claim will be used by routers to apply route policy and telemetry tagging.
maya: question: billing — if we tag activity as original_project but mark as breakglass, will billing accept that? finance will want explicit flags.
devin: i'll loop finance in if we go ahead. for now, engineering decision: do we approve prototype behind flag?
raj: approve prototype behind ff with hard caps and audit hooks.
sara: i'll draft telemetry schema and alert rules. maya can mock the modal copy.
maya: i'll do a small mock tonight.
devin: ok i'll create GH issue: "breakglass ephemeral SA flow — prototype behind flag" and assign. thanks all :thumbsup:
infra-bot: created issue #4821 by devin: https://rwd/gh/4821 "breakglass ephemeral SA flow — prototype behind flag""
